"""Byte-exact round-trip tests over the real Awesome-list fixtures.

For each committed fixture README, parse with :func:`parse_markdown`, then run
:class:`SourcePatcher` with zero inserts and require the output to equal the
source bytes exactly. Also verify each fixture parses non-trivially (>50
categories+items) and that a single inserted item changes only added lines
(diff via ``difflib``). Offline, real-fixture pattern of
``tests/test_phase3_parsers.py``.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import difflib
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from awesome_researcher.parsers.markdown_parser import parse_markdown
from awesome_researcher.renderers.list_renderer import ResourceInsert, SourcePatcher

FIXTURES_DIR = Path(__file__).parent / "fixtures"

FIXTURES = [
    "awesome-go.README.md",
    "awesome-python.README.md",
    "awesome-machine-learning.README.md",
]


def _fixture_path(name: str) -> Path:
    path = FIXTURES_DIR / name
    if not path.exists():
        pytest.skip(f"fixture not present: {path}")
    return path


def _load(name: str) -> str:
    return _fixture_path(name).read_text(encoding="utf-8")


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", FIXTURES)
def test_zero_insert_round_trip_is_byte_identical(name):
    source = _load(name)
    parsed = parse_markdown(source)
    result = SourcePatcher().patch(parsed)
    assert result.markdown == source
    assert result.inserted == []
    assert result.unmatched == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", FIXTURES)
def test_fixture_parses_non_trivially(name):
    parsed = parse_markdown(_load(name))
    total = len(parsed.categories) + parsed.item_count()
    assert total > 50, f"{name}: only {total} categories+items parsed"
    assert parsed.item_count() > 0


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", FIXTURES)
def test_single_insert_changes_only_added_lines(name):
    source = _load(name)
    parsed = parse_markdown(source)

    # Pick a real category that has at least one item so the insert anchors
    # after an existing bullet.
    target = next(
        (c for c in parsed.categories if c.items), None
    )
    assert target is not None, f"{name}: no category with items to anchor on"

    insert = ResourceInsert(
        title="Round Trip Probe",
        url="https://example.com/round-trip-probe",
        description="Temporary probe resource.",
        category=target.name,
    )
    result = SourcePatcher().patch(parsed, [insert])
    assert len(result.inserted) == 1
    assert result.unmatched == []

    diff = list(
        difflib.unified_diff(
            source.splitlines(),
            result.markdown.splitlines(),
            lineterm="",
            n=0,
        )
    )
    added = [l for l in diff if l.startswith("+") and not l.startswith("+++")]
    removed = [l for l in diff if l.startswith("-") and not l.startswith("---")]

    # Only additions: every original line survives unchanged.
    assert removed == [], f"{name}: insertion removed lines: {removed}"
    assert len(added) == 1
    assert "Round Trip Probe" in added[0]

"""Byte-exact round-trip tests against real Awesome-list fixtures.

For each committed fixture README, parsing with :func:`parse_markdown` and
re-patching with :class:`SourcePatcher` must reproduce the source byte for
byte when nothing is inserted, and a single insert must change only the
inserted lines (verified via :mod:`difflib`). Offline, real data — no network,
no mocks.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import difflib
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from awesome_researcher.parsers.markdown_parser import parse_markdown
from awesome_researcher.renderers.list_renderer import ResourceInsert, SourcePatcher

FIXTURES_DIR = Path(__file__).parent / "fixtures"

FIXTURES = [
    "awesome-go.README.md",
    "awesome-python.README.md",
    "awesome-machine-learning.README.md",
]


def _load(name: str) -> str:
    path = FIXTURES_DIR / name
    assert path.exists(), f"missing fixture: {path}"
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")


def _leaf_category_with_items(parsed):
    """Pick a real leaf category holding at least one item."""
    for cat in parsed.categories:
        if cat.is_leaf and cat.items and cat.last_item_line >= 0:
            return cat
    return None


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", FIXTURES)
def test_zero_insert_round_trip_is_byte_identical(name):
    source = _load(name)
    parsed = parse_markdown(source)
    result = SourcePatcher().patch(parsed, inserts=[])
    assert result.inserted == []
    assert result.unmatched == []
    assert result.markdown == source


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", FIXTURES)
def test_fixture_yields_nontrivial_parse(name):
    parsed = parse_markdown(_load(name))
    assert len(parsed.categories) + parsed.item_count() > 50
    assert parsed.item_count() > 0
    assert any(cat.is_leaf and cat.items for cat in parsed.categories)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", FIXTURES)
def test_single_insert_changes_only_added_lines(name):
    source = _load(name)
    parsed = parse_markdown(source)
    cat = _leaf_category_with_items(parsed)
    assert cat is not None, "fixture has no leaf category with items"

    insert = ResourceInsert(
        title="Round-Tip Probe",
        url="https://example.com/round-tip-probe",
        description="Inserted by the round-trip test.",
        category=cat.name,
    )
    result = SourcePatcher().patch(parsed, inserts=[insert])
    assert len(result.inserted) == 1
    assert result.unmatched == []

    diff = list(
        difflib.unified_diff(
            source.splitlines(keepends=True),
            result.markdown.splitlines(keepends=True),
            n=0,
        )
    )
    added = [l for l in diff if l.startswith("+") and not l.startswith("+++")]
    removed = [l for l in diff if l.startswith("-") and not l.startswith("---")]
    # Only additions: every original line survives untouched.
    assert removed == []
    assert added == ["- [Round-Tip Probe](https://example.com/round-tip-probe) "
                     "- Inserted by the round-trip test.\n"]
    # The insert landed immediately after the category's last item line.
    rec = result.inserted[0]
    assert rec.after_line == cat.last_item_line
    assert rec.matched_category == cat.name
    # Removing the inserted line restores the source exactly.
    patched_lines = result.markdown.splitlines(keepends=True)
    restored = patched_lines[: rec.after_line + 1] + patched_lines[rec.after_line + 2 :]
    assert "".join(restored) == source
